verdict.rationale: Fern is a documentation platform, so theme and branding customization is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack never documents themes, fonts, layout controls, custom CSS/JS, or custom components. Custom domains, versions, and the 'branded' generated CLI are adjacent features that do not cover this story.

support.subject: As a DevRel lead, I customize themes, fonts, and layout — down to custom CSS/JS or my own components — so the docs match my brand
